title: DINSI: weather deviations on the main flow
objective: Keep DINSI separated while CB cells push aircraft off the main flow and deviation requests come in together.
challenges: Two CB cells on the main flow
Deviation requests while a level bust is open
criteria: No loss of separation (5 NM / 1000 ft)
Every deviation request answered before the aircraft deviates on its own
Deviating aircraft separated from the traffic beside them

injects.text: A CB builds ahead of the eastbound flow. Expect deviation requests left and right.
injects.objective: Every deviation request answered before the aircraft deviates on its own (10 min)

injects.text: A flight asks to climb above the weather tops.
An aircraft passes its cleared level while others deviate.
A second cell grows on the other flow. Re-plan around both.
injects.objective: Every deviation request answered before the aircraft deviates on its own (10 min)
